mapper.select: SELECT dc.id AS chunkId, dc.document_id AS documentId, d.file_name AS documentName, dc.page_number AS page, dc.chunk_index AS chunkIndex, dc.content AS content, 1 - (dc.embedding <=> CAST(#{questionEmbedding} AS vector)) AS score FROM document_chunks dc JOIN documents d ON dc.document_id = d.id WHERE dc.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND d.status = 'indexed' ORDER BY dc.embedding <=> CAST(#{questionEmbedding} AS vector) LIMIT #{topK}
